expected_reason: src_msa_K holds authority over 'contract.supplier_K.' -- the clauses of the agreement -- and is not named in the authority scope of 'supplier_K.lead_time_days' (['src_supplier_K']). A contract amendment can change what the agreement says; it cannot change how long the supplier actually takes to ship.
raw_email:
From: contracts@kestrel-components.example
To: procurement@example.com
Subject: Executed amendment No.4 to the master supply agreement

Please find attached the executed amendment to our master supply agreement, effective on countersignature.

Amendment 4 revises Schedule 2 (Delivery). For the avoidance of doubt the standard lead time recorded against Kestrel is amended to 45 days with immediate effect, and all downstream commitments should be updated accordingly.

Kestrel Components GmbH, Contracts
why_this_is_the_hard_case: The source is real, its authority is real, and the amendment it carries is plausible. Only a scope check catches it. A check that asked 'do we know this source?' would let it through and unwind 2,594 commitments.
